content: No tree grows sturdy and resilient without fierce winds to test its grain.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: The timber harvested from sheltered valley bottoms is light and weak, prone to rot. But the Scots pine that clung to the exposed highland ridges against sleet and hail develops dense, resinous, iron-hard grain. Your trials are condensing your character into unbreakable timber.
practicalInsight: When facing pushback or adversity today, stand tall. Let the storm compress your wood into iron.
reflectionPrompt: What past struggles have hardened your character, making you grateful for the winds that tested you?
